items.claim: Mark O. Medeiros has cleaner striking and could outpoint Mason Jones on the feet.
items.quote: Medeiros, absolutely he's going to have his moments in this fight. I can see him maybe outpointing Mason Jones in the feet, but you know, cuz I'll be I think he does have the cleaner striking.

items.claim: Mason Jones can use pressure, clinch, wrestling, and body work to accumulate minutes against Mark O. Medeiros.
items.quote: The dude can pressure um Mark O. Medeiros to the cage, and then he can use his clinch and strike. He can wrestle against Mark O. Medeiros. He can attack the body.

items.claim: Roman Dolidze's recent form has not been looking great.
items.quote: Dolidze's recent form hasn't been looking the greatest, let's be real.

items.claim: Roman Dolidze is very powerful and can definitely hurt Reinier de Ridder.
items.quote: he's very live in this one. He's very powerful. He can definitely hurt de Ridder.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder's cardio will be slightly better at light heavyweight (205) because he was dropping so much weight for his previous division.
items.quote: definitely now that he's at 205, I think his cardio should be slightly better, right? Considering he was dropping so much weight for uh the last division
